disclaimer: All vulnerability identifiers are verified real-world CVEs from NIST NVD and CISA KEV catalogs cached locally for air-gapped operation.

vulnerabilities.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution (ProxyShell)
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Apply Microsoft Cumulative Update & disable external PowerShell virtual directories.

vulnerabilities.title: Microsoft Exchange Server SSRF (ProxyLogon)
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Install emergency Exchange security updates and place behind reverse proxy.

vulnerabilities.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1+ or remove JndiLookup.class.

vulnerabilities.title: XZ Utils Malicious Backdoor Injection
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Downgrade xz-utils to 5.4.6 or build from vetted uncompromised tarballs.

vulnerabilities.title: runc Container Escape to Host Filesystem
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Update runc to 1.1.12+ across container runtime worker nodes.

vulnerabilities.title: Microsoft Outlook NTLM Hash Leak via MAPI Property
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Apply Microsoft Office security update and block outbound SMB (TCP 445).

vulnerabilities.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Command Injection
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Apply Ivanti ICT mitigation XML file and patch release.

vulnerabilities.title: libwebp Heap Buffer Overflow
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Deploy updated browser builds with patched libwebp library.

vulnerabilities.title: WinRAR File Extension Spoofing Arbitrary Code Execution
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Update WinRAR to version 6.23 or higher.

vulnerabilities.title: Progress Software MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Apply MOVEit Service Pack and disable all external HTTP/HTTPS access until verified.

vulnerabilities.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC / Gateway Sensitive Information Disclosure (Citrix Bleed)
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Install Citrix NetScaler security update and kill all active session cookies.

vulnerabilities.title: Windows Remote Desktop Licensing Service Remote Code Execution (MadLicense)
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Apply Microsoft July 2024 Patch Tuesday update or disable RDL service if unneeded.

vulnerabilities.title: OpenSSH Server Signal Handler Race Condition RCE (regreSSHion)
vulnerabilities.base_remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or set LoginGraceTime to 0 in sshd_config.
